summary: Full backend + frontend testing of Live POD Operations Dashboard. All 26 pytest cases pass (auth, meta, overview + filters, tpms, pods, users + detail, audit, data-health, admin manual sync, viewer 403, unauth 401). Frontend E2E: login as admin lands on /overview showing Headcount=333, 15 PODs, 4 TPMs, baseline insight; sidebar navigation across all 6 pages works; POD detail with 6 nested tabs (overview/people/work-status/trinity/manual/changes) render; user rows (333) clickable; TPM rows (4) render; theme toggle switches dark<->light; global filter search persists to URL query (?search=john); admin Sync-now triggers manual sync with success toast ("Sync success · 2 changes") and Data Health page updates; viewer login correctly hides Sync-now button; Data Health shows Fresh state, poll interval 60s, and recent runs table with per-run change counts.
action_items: (Optional) Align UserDetail tab data-testids to spec names (user-tab-current-status/daily-history/audit-trail) and rename filter-clear-all -> filter-clear for consistency with the reviewer spec.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~750 lines and mixes auth, sync engine, query helpers, and routes; consider splitting into routers (auth.py, sync.py, dashboard.py) as the app grows.

In /api/meta, `tpms = pods = roles = projects = employments = statuses = []` assigns the SAME list reference to all six names; harmless only because each is reassigned inside the `if snap:` block, but risky if that branch is ever skipped conditionally.
poller() runs unconditionally on startup with no jitter/backoff on repeated failures; if the sheet API errors persist, this hammers the service every 60s.
CORS uses allow_origins='*' by default while allow_credentials=True; browsers reject credentialed requests when origin is '*'. Explicitly configure CORS_ORIGINS in production.

diff_people compares status_tokens_lower via prev.get(...) but prev people docs come from a stored snapshot that already contains that field; ensure old snapshots created before this field existed still work (backfill or default) — currently defaulted with .get([]) so OK.
user_detail loads all snapshots into memory (to_list(1000)); acceptable now (single date) but will scale linearly with days × 333 people; consider projection/aggregation.

success_rate.frontend: 100% functional; 2 minor testid naming mismatches vs spec

seed_data_creation: None. Data is live-synced from Google Sheets Master tab; baseline 2026-09-17 already present (333 people, 15 PODs, 4 TPMs).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (pytest, session-scoped tokens). Sheet is live; person_count fluctuates slightly on each 60s poll (e.g. Trinity 44.4% -> 44.1%) so avoid asserting exact percentages, headcount=333 is stable. Sync-now generates a success toast that overlays the top-right corner and intercepts clicks on nearby buttons (e.g. theme toggle); wait ~4s or use force=True. UserDetail tab testids are user-tab-{summary,current,history,audit} (not current-status/daily-history/audit-trail). Filter clear testid is filter-clear-all.
